name: drive-screenshot-to-xero-sales-invoice

trigger.authentication_note: Google Drive dennis@work.flowers. The SAME connection is needed twice: here on the trigger (which polls the folder) and as the `gdrive` alias in --connections, because the workflow code renames the file.
trigger.trigger_note: Polling trigger (New File in Folder), one run per file added to the Notion Setup Session Invoices folder. No webhook_url — nothing external needs a catch URL, so the cutover was just disabling the classic Zap (done by Dennis before this migration started).

connectionless_apps.AICLIAPI: get_completion — authentication_id "0" (Included in Plan), no connection

xero.invoice_type: new_sales_invoice (ACCREC) — billing Notion Labs, Inc., NOT a bill like drive-invoice-to-xero
xero.reference: PO #8900 — fixed per Dennis; the classic Zap's Zap Component variable value wasn't present in the exported Zap JSON, so it was supplied directly rather than guessed
xero.line_items_shape_note: new_sales_invoice's line_items is a fieldset of OBJECTS (array), confirmed live via list-action-input-fields — NOT five parallel top-level arrays. Each object carries its own line_item_code, line_description, line_quantity, line_account_code, line_tax_type, line_items_type.
xero.no_contact_id_field_note: new_sales_invoice has no contact_id input, same as new_bill on the bill side (see drive-invoice-to-xero). Safe here because contact_name is a fixed literal, never text read off a document, so there is no spelling drift for Xero's by-name match to fork into a duplicate contact.

item_codes.note: Ported verbatim from the classic Zap's Formatter 'Lookup Table' step (util.lookup).

ai_model.tier_note: NOT the repo's default standard/auto. A/B'd across three real screenshots already in the Drive folder (2026-04-30, 2026-05-31, 2026-06-30) before publishing. standard/auto and advanced/auto agreed exactly on 2026-04-30 (12 lines) and 2026-05-31 (8 lines), but on 2026-06-30 standard/auto silently dropped a real line — Ernest Choo, Calls Completed: 2 — reproduced on a second standard/auto run of the same screenshot. advanced/auto caught it both times. A dropped line here is under-billed revenue with no error anywhere, so the extra task cost is the right trade. Re-run this comparison (offline via run-action against real screenshots, never by running the durable) before ever downgrading.
ai_model.output_shape_note: isOutputArray:true; rows live at data[0].result.items. Uses the outputSchema + type_/required_/options_ per-field mechanism (byte-identical to what the classic Zap's exported JSON already used), not the outputFields JSON-array mechanism drive-invoice-to-xero uses — both are valid; this migration kept the classic Zap's original shape since it was already verified live across three real screenshots.
ai_model.file_input_note: The screenshot is passed to the model as an image input (inputFieldConfig_Screenshot_isImageUrl), using the Drive trigger's `file` hydrate reference.

determinism_note: No calendar arithmetic is needed — the AI already returns the reporting month's last day — so unlike drive-invoice-to-xero there's no daysFromCivil/isoDateFromEpochMs pair. toIsoDate + daysInMonth exist purely to validate the AI's date string is a real calendar date via integer math before it reaches Xero. `Date` is not referenced anywhere in workflow.ts.
rename_gotcha: update_file_name's `file` input takes the plain Drive file ID (file.id), NOT the AI step's hydrate token (file.fileRef) used for image content. Passing the hydrate token 404s — caught live during pre-publish testing (run 019fd188), fixed before the version that actually published. drive-invoice-to-xero's rename step already used file.id; this migration initially missed that and copied file.fileRef by mistake.
description: Monthly 'Notion Setup Sessions' activity screenshot added to the Drive folder -> AI by Zapier (advanced/auto) extracts one line item per consultant/session-type combination -> map session type to Xero item code -> resolve the invoice period (majority value across rows) -> create a DRAFT Xero sales invoice billing Notion Labs, Inc. -> rename the screenshot to '<invoice period> Notion Setup Sessions'. Migration of the classic Zap 'Generate Setup Session Invoice'. Unlike drive-invoice-to-xero (which raises bills against varying vendor names extracted from documents), this Zap bills one fixed, constant customer, so it carries none of that Zap's vendor-contact-resolution complexity.
testing_note: Tested end-to-end via run-durable against the real, already-processed 2026-06-30 screenshot before publishing (repo rule: never test only the skip path). First attempt hit the rename bug above; the invoice it created (a773938c-5112-4bd4-9ad8-281265a5b504) was deleted from Xero via update_sales_invoice invoice_status=deleted (confirmed via a raw GET afterward). Second attempt, with the fix, completed cleanly (invoiceId 0cda0de5-d87d-45ec-a654-70a19da84311, 10 line items, invoicePeriod 2026-06-30, periodUnanimous true, renamedTo matching the file's existing name) and was likewise deleted from Xero as a test artifact before publishing — production runs start clean.

replaces_classic_zap.title: Generate Setup Session Invoice
replaces_classic_zap.old_shape: Drive trigger (any file) -> Filter (Image Only) -> AI extraction (OpenAI gpt-5.4-mini via AI by Zapier) -> Formatter Lookup Table (session type -> item code) -> Formatter Line-item-to-Text (collapse Invoice Period array to one string) -> Xero new_sales_invoice -> Google Drive rename
replaces_classic_zap.status: Dennis disabled the classic Zap before this migration began. No webhook cutover needed — purely a polling Drive trigger.
replaces_classic_zap.recovered_from_export: Everything in the exported Zap JSON except the Xero invoice's Reference field, which was a Zap Component variable (Components.variables['019c4004-7a2f-e4f0-9712-2a03fe4969ce']) whose value the export does not carry. Supplied directly by Dennis as 'PO #8900'.
replaces_classic_zap.model_change: Classic Zap pinned OpenAI gpt-5.4-mini explicitly (provider_id/model_id on AI by Zapier). This migration uses the repo's tier-sentinel convention instead (advanced/auto), chosen after A/B testing per the ai_model note above rather than carried over unexamined.
